[LTES.2.3.2]

| Test shape | Example |
|---|---|
| Semantic: given LHS, confirm activation | assert fact set, expect rule fire with specific bindings |
| Temporal: clock-driven re-evaluation | step clock, expect `logical` fact retraction / `after` timer fire |
| Adapter: mock adapter, verify emit path | feed mocked adapter responses, confirm rule reactions |
| Cross-tier: publish correctness | drive tier A, observe tier B working memory |
| Back-pressure: overflow policies | flood queue, verify `drop-oldest` / `persist-through-storage` |
| Recovery: an unreachable adapter | have the call callback return a `CallError` ([LCRS.10.6.1]), observe the rules that match it |
